chapters.title: Chapter 1796: Stabilizing Genesis Flames!
paragraphs: Varkhon laughed and grabbed three Genesis Flames with one hand, but the moment he did, six guardians turned toward him at once.
Tamara captured two flames with her spear aura, then spun around and blocked Varkhon from grabbing a fourth.
Varkhon grinned at her. "Already competing?"
Tamara answered with a spear thrust. "You said you wanted this kind of trial."
Their attacks collided, and the shockwave scattered several nearby flames.

Revona did not rush greedily. Her Void Origin Eyes locked onto two flames drifting between several cube beasts, and she made the attacks around them vanish just long enough to step through and take them calmly.
Ervin moved like a shadow with his spear, piercing the air around three flames and pulling them toward himself through precise spear force.
Max’s Dimensional Sovereign Body saw every flame at once.

He knew which ones were bait, which ones would attract stronger guardians, and which ones were about to vanish into the arena floor. Instead of grabbing the nearest flames, he moved toward the far side of the core where five flames were drifting into a dangerous cube storm. He stepped through the shifting space, avoiding three hidden traps, and caught all five flames in one motion.
The system reacted immediately.
[Genesis Flame Count Increased.]
[Participant Max Morgan Has Obtained 5 Genesis Flames.]
[Guardian Aggression Toward Participant Max Morgan Increased.]
The arena trembled.
A larger guardian began forming above Max.

It looked like a knight made of white cubes, holding a massive sword of Genesis light. At the same time, two smaller guardians appeared behind him, while the cube storm in front of him turned into a rotating prison.
Tamara saw it and shouted, "Taking five at once was greedy."
Max glanced at her. "I can hold them."
The Genesis knight descended.
Max moved.

Dragonheart flashed, seven-colored lightning erupted, and his Dimensional Sovereign Body guided him through the rotating cube prison without taking a single hit. He did not destroy the knight immediately. Instead, he led it toward the area where several loose Genesis Flames were drifting near Varkhon and Tamara’s clash.
Varkhon noticed and cursed. "Human, do not bring that thing here."
Max smiled faintly. "This is also part of the trial."
The Genesis knight swung its sword.
Varkhon and Tamara were forced to stop fighting each other and block together.
Boom!
The giant sword crashed down, and the impact blasted both of them backward. Max used that instant to take one more Genesis Flame that had been floating between them.
Tamara’s eyes sharpened. "Max."
Varkhon laughed angrily. "Now I like this trial."
Revona watched all this and quietly moved to take another flame that everyone had ignored.

Ervin saw her move and smiled faintly, then pierced the ground with his spear. A hidden pulse pushed the flame slightly away from Revona and toward him. Revona’s Void Origin Eyes flashed, and the pulse vanished, allowing her to take the flame after all.
Ervin looked at her. "Well done."
Revona replied calmly, "You too."
The trial had become exactly what the system intended.
They cooperated when the guardians became too dangerous.
They competed when flames became available.
They blocked each other without fully trying to kill.
They stole opportunities without destroying the team structure entirely.
For several minutes, the arena became chaotic.

Max fought the Genesis knight while holding several flames, forcing him to display terrifying adaptability. His Dimensional Sovereign Body allowed him to avoid blind attacks, see through shifting cube traps, and choose the safest route while still stealing more flames whenever an opening appeared.

Tamara and Varkhon clashed several times over the same flames, but whenever too many guardians attacked, they fought back-to-back with surprising efficiency. Revona used her Void Origin Eyes to erase attacks, traps, and even the pull of several Genesis Flames when others tried to steal from her.

Ervin’s spear moved like an abyssal line through the battlefield, sometimes protecting the group, sometimes stealing flames, sometimes forcing guardians into the paths of others with subtle precision.
Then the timer reached the final five minutes.
[Genesis Flame Possession Will Now Stabilize Every 60 Seconds.]
[Stabilized Genesis Flames Cannot Be Stolen.]
The rule changed the entire battle.

Everyone immediately understood that the next few minutes mattered most. Flames held long enough would become safe, and that meant the competition would become more aggressive before each stabilization.
Varkhon grinned widely. "Now this is fun."
Tamara’s war intent surged. "Then hold what you can."
The guardians roared.
The Genesis knight turned toward Max again.
Revona’s Void Origin Eyes glowed deeper.
Ervin lifted his spear.
Max held the Genesis Flames around him and looked at the timer.
The moment the final five minutes began, the entire Genesis Core Dominion arena changed.

The cubic floor beneath them lit up with white patterns, and each participant’s Genesis Flames began circling their bodies like small burning stars. Max had the most flames around him, and because of that, the pressure on him became the heaviest.
The Genesis knight that had been chasing him suddenly grew larger, its white cube armor rearranging into thicker plates, while a second sword of Genesis light formed in its other hand.
At the same time, several smaller guardians turned toward Max, their glowing cores locking onto the flames surrounding him as if the trial itself had decided that his greed needed to be punished.
Tamara glanced toward him while sweeping her spear through two cube beasts. "You really attracted half the arena."

Max avoided the Genesis knight’s first sword by shifting half a step to the side, then turned Dragonheart and blocked the second sword head-on. The collision sent a shockwave across the platform, but his body did not move back.
"Only half?" he said calmly. "Then the trial is not that hard."
Varkhon laughed loudly from the other side of the battlefield. He was holding several Genesis Flames of his own, and a group of cubic wolves were tearing toward him from three directions.

Instead of dodging, he charged directly into them with his demonic markings blazing. His fist smashed the first wolf into pieces, his shoulder rammed through the second, and his hand grabbed the third by its cube-shaped neck before hurling it toward Tamara’s side.
Tamara’s eyes narrowed. "Varkhon."
The demon grinned. "Teamwork."

Tamara snorted coldly, but she still thrust her spear forward and destroyed the flying wolf before it could crash into her. However, the brief distraction gave Varkhon a chance to rush toward a drifting Genesis Flame nearby. He almost grabbed it, but before his fingers touched it, a thin black spear light pierced the air and knocked the flame away.
Ervin stood several platforms away, his spear lowered as if he had done nothing.
Varkhon turned toward him with a dangerous smile. "You are annoying."
Ervin smiled faintly. "You were too slow."

sentences.text: Varkhon laughed and grabbed three Genesis Flames with one hand, but the moment he did, six guardians turned toward him at once.
Tamara captured two flames with her spear aura, then spun around and blocked Varkhon from grabbing a fourth.
Varkhon grinned at her.
"Already competing?"
Tamara answered with a spear thrust.
"You said you wanted this kind of trial."
Their attacks collided, and the shockwave scattered several nearby flames.
Revona did not rush greedily.
Her Void Origin Eyes locked onto two flames drifting between several cube beasts, and she made the attacks around them vanish just long enough to step through and take them calmly.
Ervin moved like a shadow with his spear, piercing the air around three flames and pulling them toward himself through precise spear force.
Max’s Dimensional Sovereign Body saw every flame at once.
He knew which ones were bait, which ones would attract stronger guardians, and which ones were about to vanish into the arena floor.
Instead of grabbing the nearest flames, he moved toward the far side of the core where five flames were drifting into a dangerous cube storm.
He stepped through the shifting space, avoiding three hidden traps, and caught all five flames in one motion.
The system reacted immediately.
[Genesis Flame Count Increased.]
[Participant Max Morgan Has Obtained 5 Genesis Flames.]
[Guardian Aggression Toward Participant Max Morgan Increased.]
The arena trembled.
A larger guardian began forming above Max.
It looked like a knight made of white cubes, holding a massive sword of Genesis light.
At the same time, two smaller guardians appeared behind him, while the cube storm in front of him turned into a rotating prison.
Tamara saw it and shouted, "Taking five at once was greedy."
Max glanced at her.
"I can hold them."
The Genesis knight descended.
Max moved.
Dragonheart flashed, seven-colored lightning erupted, and his Dimensional Sovereign Body guided him through the rotating cube prison without taking a single hit.
He did not destroy the knight immediately.
Instead, he led it toward the area where several loose Genesis Flames were drifting near Varkhon and Tamara’s clash.
Varkhon noticed and cursed.
"Human, do not bring that thing here."
Max smiled faintly.
"This is also part of the trial."
The Genesis knight swung its sword.
Varkhon and Tamara were forced to stop fighting each other and block together.
Boom!
The giant sword crashed down, and the impact blasted both of them backward.
Max used that instant to take one more Genesis Flame that had been floating between them.
Tamara’s eyes sharpened.
"Max."
Varkhon laughed angrily.
"Now I like this trial."
Revona watched all this and quietly moved to take another flame that everyone had ignored.
Ervin saw her move and smiled faintly, then pierced the ground with his spear.
A hidden pulse pushed the flame slightly away from Revona and toward him.
Revona’s Void Origin Eyes flashed, and the pulse vanished, allowing her to take the flame after all.
Ervin looked at her.
"Well done."
Revona replied calmly, "You too."
The trial had become exactly what the system intended.
They cooperated when the guardians became too dangerous.
They competed when flames became available.
They blocked each other without fully trying to kill.
They stole opportunities without destroying the team structure entirely.
For several minutes, the arena became chaotic.
Max fought the Genesis knight while holding several flames, forcing him to display terrifying adaptability.
His Dimensional Sovereign Body allowed him to avoid blind attacks, see through shifting cube traps, and choose the safest route while still stealing more flames whenever an opening appeared.
Tamara and Varkhon clashed several times over the same flames, but whenever too many guardians attacked, they fought back-to-back with surprising efficiency.
Revona used her Void Origin Eyes to erase attacks, traps, and even the pull of several Genesis Flames when others tried to steal from her.

Ervin’s spear moved like an abyssal line through the battlefield, sometimes protecting the group, sometimes stealing flames, sometimes forcing guardians into the paths of others with subtle precision.
Then the timer reached the final five minutes.
[Genesis Flame Possession Will Now Stabilize Every 60 Seconds.]
[Stabilized Genesis Flames Cannot Be Stolen.]
The rule changed the entire battle.
Everyone immediately understood that the next few minutes mattered most.
Flames held long enough would become safe, and that meant the competition would become more aggressive before each stabilization.
Varkhon grinned widely.
"Now this is fun."
Tamara’s war intent surged.
"Then hold what you can."
The guardians roared.
The Genesis knight turned toward Max again.
Revona’s Void Origin Eyes glowed deeper.
Ervin lifted his spear.
Max held the Genesis Flames around him and looked at the timer.
The moment the final five minutes began, the entire Genesis Core Dominion arena changed.
The cubic floor beneath them lit up with white patterns, and each participant’s Genesis Flames began circling their bodies like small burning stars.
Max had the most flames around him, and because of that, the pressure on him became the heaviest.
The Genesis knight that had been chasing him suddenly grew larger, its white cube armor rearranging into thicker plates, while a second sword of Genesis light formed in its other hand.
At the same time, several smaller guardians turned toward Max, their glowing cores locking onto the flames surrounding him as if the trial itself had decided that his greed needed to be punished.
Tamara glanced toward him while sweeping her spear through two cube beasts.
"You really attracted half the arena."
Max avoided the Genesis knight’s first sword by shifting half a step to the side, then turned Dragonheart and blocked the second sword head-on.
The collision sent a shockwave across the platform, but his body did not move back.
"Only half?" he said calmly.
"Then the trial is not that hard."
Varkhon laughed loudly from the other side of the battlefield.
He was holding several Genesis Flames of his own, and a group of cubic wolves were tearing toward him from three directions.
Instead of dodging, he charged directly into them with his demonic markings blazing.
His fist smashed the first wolf into pieces, his shoulder rammed through the second, and his hand grabbed the third by its cube-shaped neck before hurling it toward Tamara’s side.
Tamara’s eyes narrowed.
"Varkhon."
The demon grinned.
"Teamwork."
Tamara snorted coldly, but she still thrust her spear forward and destroyed the flying wolf before it could crash into her.
However, the brief distraction gave Varkhon a chance to rush toward a drifting Genesis Flame nearby.
He almost grabbed it, but before his fingers touched it, a thin black spear light pierced the air and knocked the flame away.
Ervin stood several platforms away, his spear lowered as if he had done nothing.
Varkhon turned toward him with a dangerous smile.
"You are annoying."
Ervin smiled faintly.
"You were too slow."

chapters.title: Chapter 1797: Five Minutes Timer!
paragraphs: The flame that Ervin had knocked away drifted toward Revona’s side, but Revona did not reach for it immediately. Her Void Origin Eyes flashed, and an invisible cube trap around the flame vanished.

Only then did she stretch out her hand and take it calmly. The moment she obtained it, two guardians rushed toward her from the void below, but before they could reach her, she looked at them once. Their bodies became faint, then the attacks forming inside their cores disappeared into nothingness.
A breath later, Ervin’s spear pierced through both weakened cores from afar, destroying them before they could recover.
Revona looked at him. "Thank you."
Ervin replied, "You removed the dangerous part. I only finished the rest."

Even while competing, none of them fully ignored cooperation. That was the cruel balance of the trial. If they focused only on stealing from one another, the guardians would overwhelm them. If they focused only on helping one another, the marks would not be distributed in their favor.
Every movement had to carry two meanings, survival and advantage, defense and theft, assistance and calculation.
The timer continued falling.
The Genesis Flames around everyone trembled faintly, and the first stabilization was approaching.

Max had already understood the rhythm of the trial. The flames needed to be held for sixty seconds before becoming stable, but the closer the stabilization came, the more aggressive the guardians became.
The system was not giving them free rewards. It was forcing them to defend their gains under increasing pressure while tempting others to steal at the last moment.
The Genesis knight raised both swords.
The space around Max shifted.

Dozens of cube blades appeared from every side, and the knight itself vanished from his front, reappearing behind him through a sudden spatial shift. If it had been anyone else, that attack might have struck before they even sensed the danger.

But Max’s Dimensional Sovereign Body had no blind spot. He saw the spatial shift from the moment it began, saw the cube blades forming around him, and saw the hidden flame behind the knight that the trial had placed as bait.
Max moved.

His body slipped through the smallest gap between the cube blades, Dragonheart curved behind him without looking, and his sword edge met the knight’s twin swords with perfect timing. Sparks of Genesis light burst outward.
The knight’s attack was redirected to the side, and Max’s left hand reached through the gap between two shifting cubes, pulling the bait flame into his possession before the trap fully activated.
[Participant Max Morgan Has Obtained 1 Genesis Flame.]
[Guardian Aggression Toward Participant Max Morgan Increased.]
Varkhon looked over and laughed. "You are insane. You are still taking more?"
Max’s eyes remained calm as he kicked off the platform and moved away from the Genesis knight’s next strike. "The trial placed it there."
Tamara shouted, "It placed it there to kill you."
Max slashed apart three cube blades and replied, "Then it should try harder."
The words made Varkhon laugh again, while even Tamara’s mouth twitched slightly. Revona only shook her head faintly, and Ervin’s smile deepened as if he found Max’s response interesting.
Then the first stabilization arrived.
[Genesis Flame Stabilization Initiated.]
White light descended on the arena.

Several flames around each participant changed color, becoming more solid and sinking into their trial marks. The unstable flames that had been circling them became divided into two types. The stabilized ones could no longer be stolen, while the unstable ones still remained vulnerable.
[Stabilized Genesis Flames Cannot Be Stolen.]
Max felt several of his flames become safe, but he did not relax. The moment stabilization ended, the trial released a new wave of guardians.
This time, the guardians were different.
Five Genesis knights appeared, one for each participant.

Each knight carried a weapon reflecting the person it targeted. The one facing Tamara held a cube spear. The one facing Varkhon had massive gauntlets. The one facing Revona had mirror-like eyes that seemed designed to resist erasure. The one facing Ervin held a long black-white spear. The one facing Max carried a sword, but its body was wrapped in faint spatial distortions.
[Personal Genesis Guardians Awakened.]
[Warning: Personal Guardians Will Adapt To Participant Combat Style.]
Tamara’s smile became fierce. "Now this is better."

Her spear collided with the cube spear of her personal guardian, and the sound rang across the arena like two armies crashing together. The guardian’s spear arts were not weak. It copied the rhythm of Tamara’s war spear, using formation-like footwork and heavy battlefield pressure to match her advance.
Tamara’s eyes grew sharper, and her war intent surged as she began overpowering it through sheer dominance.
Varkhon’s guardian rushed at him with both gauntlets raised.
The demon met it with a punch.

The two fists collided, and the platform beneath them cracked. Varkhon’s grin turned savage as the guardian punched again and again, each strike growing heavier as it adapted to his raw strength. Instead of retreating, Varkhon became even more excited. His demonic markings burned brighter, and he started trading blows with the guardian like a beast enjoying a storm.
Revona’s guardian was the strangest.

It did not attack immediately. Its mirror-like eyes stared directly at her Void Origin Eyes, and the space between them became distorted as erasure and reflection fought in silence. Revona’s expression became more serious than before.

The guardian had been created to resist her, and each time she tried to erase part of its attack structure, the mirror-like surface reflected part of that power back toward her. She stepped back, adjusted her gaze, and began targeting the gaps between the reflection layers instead of the surface itself.
Ervin faced his spear guardian calmly.
For several breaths, neither moved.
Then both attacked at once.

Two spear lights crossed in the air, one black-silver and one white-black. Their movements were so fast and precise that even Tamara glanced over for a moment. Ervin’s spear was monstrous, but the guardian was learning with every exchange.
It copied his angles, mirrored his distance, and tried to predict his next point of attack. Ervin’s smile did not vanish. If anything, it became a little more genuine.
Max’s personal guardian attacked last.
Its sword cut through space.

The slash did not travel normally. It vanished halfway and appeared near Max’s neck. At the same time, the guardian’s body blurred, creating three false spatial positions around him. The trial had understood that ordinary attacks would not work against his perception, so it used spatial distortion, false position, and delayed sword cuts to interfere with his senses.

chapters.title: Chapter 1798: Outer Regions!
paragraphs: Max’s Dimensional Sovereign Body expanded.
He saw the real sword.
He saw the false cuts.
He saw the delayed attack hidden beneath the platform.
He saw the guardian’s core shifting between its chest, head, and sword hilt.
"No blind spots," Max said softly.
Dragonheart moved.
One slash destroyed the delayed attack beneath him.
The second blocked the sword near his neck.
The third pierced the false spatial body on his left and forced the real guardian to reveal itself.
The fourth struck the guardian’s sword hilt and cracked the hidden core inside.
The guardian staggered back.

Max stepped forward and kicked it in the chest, sending it flying into the Genesis knight that had been chasing him earlier. The two guardians collided, and before they could separate, Max raised his hand and sent a seven-colored lightning bolt through both of their bodies.
The lightning did not fully destroy them, but it disrupted their structure long enough for him to move toward two unstable flames drifting near the center.
Ervin saw Max going for them.
His spear flashed.
A thin spear force shot toward one of the flames, trying to pull it away.
Max’s left hand moved slightly, and space distorted around the flame, shifting it out of the spear force’s path.
Ervin’s eyes flickered.
Max caught the flame.

Revona’s Void Origin Eyes then targeted the second flame, erasing the guardian’s pull around it. But before she could take it, Tamara’s spear struck the ground, sending a wave of war intent that pushed the flame toward her side.
Varkhon appeared from the opposite direction and punched the platform, causing the flame to bounce upward. For a brief instant, all four of them competed for the same flame.
Then Max used his Dimensional Sovereign Body to step into the precise point where all their forces canceled each other.
He took the flame.
Four gazes turned toward him.
Max looked calm. "Good teamwork."
Varkhon stared at him for a moment, then burst into laughter. "You shameless human."
Tamara shook her head, though her war intent rose again. "Do not think you can keep stealing like that."
Revona did not seem angry, but her Void Origin Eyes became deeper. "Then we should stop creating openings for him."
Ervin smiled faintly. "Agreed."
For the next minute, the competition grew sharper.

Tamara, Varkhon, Revona, and Ervin began subtly limiting Max’s opportunities, but they could not fully ignore the guardians either. Max, meanwhile, had to deal with the highest guardian aggression because he still held the most unstable flames.

The trial pressed him with increasing force, sending his personal guardian, the Genesis knight, and several smaller beasts against him at once. He moved through the attacks with terrifying precision, but even he had to admit that the trial was becoming troublesome.
The second stabilization approached.
The arena floor shifted again.
Several platforms began sinking into the void.
The central core released a pulse, and the remaining loose Genesis Flames scattered toward the five outer regions.
[Genesis Flame Scatter Initiated.]
[Outer Regions Activated.]
[Participants May Claim Outer Regions To Increase Stabilization Speed.]
The five colored outer regions lit up fully.

Max immediately understood the new rule. If someone controlled an outer region, the flames they held would stabilize faster, but staying in one region also made them easier to target. It was another balance of risk and reward.
Tamara was the first to move.
She flew toward the crimson region and planted her spear into the ground. War runes spread outward, and the region accepted her power.
[Participant Tamara Has Claimed Crimson War Region.]
[Stabilization Speed Increased.]
Varkhon laughed and charged into the black region.
[Participant Varkhon Has Claimed Black Destruction Region.]
Revona calmly stepped into the silver region.
[Participant Revona Has Claimed Silver Void Region.]
Ervin moved toward the blue region, his spear resting against his shoulder.
[Participant Ervin Has Claimed Blue Abyss Region.]
Max looked at the remaining gold region.

The Genesis knight and his personal guardian were between him and that region, while several smaller guardians moved to block the path. The trial had clearly made his route harder because he had the highest flame count.
Max smiled faintly.
His Vein of Speed came to life.
In the next instant, he disappeared.
The guardians attacked empty air.
Max appeared inside the gold region and placed his foot on the glowing cubic platform.
[Participant Max Morgan Has Claimed Gold Dominion Region.]
[Stabilization Speed Increased.]
The second stabilization began almost immediately.

White light descended once again, and several more flames became fixed into the participants’ marks. Max felt another portion of his flames stabilize, and the pressure around him finally lessened slightly. The others also secured part of their gains, but the remaining unstable flames still circled them, waiting for the final stage of the trial.
[Remaining Time: 03:00]
[Final Phase Initiated.]
[Rule Update: Participants May Invade Outer Regions.]
[Rule Update: Defeating A Personal Guardian Grants 1 Bonus Genesis Flame.]
[Rule Update: Final Genesis Flame Will Appear At 01:00.]
The moment the final phase began, the arena became even more dangerous.
Tamara looked toward Max’s region.
Varkhon looked toward Ervin’s.
Ervin looked toward the center.
Revona looked at all of them.
Max’s personal guardian slowly rose again, its cracked sword hilt glowing as the hidden core repaired itself.
Then the final battle of the second trial began.
Varkhon invaded Ervin’s Blue Abyss Region first.

The demon crossed three platforms in a single leap, his fist descending like a meteor toward Ervin’s head. Ervin did not retreat. His spear rose and met the fist at an angle, redirecting most of the force while the ground beneath him cracked apart.

The two clashed violently, raw demonic strength against abyssal spearmanship. Varkhon’s strikes were heavy enough to crush platforms, but Ervin’s spear always found the weakest point of each attack, turning aside what could be turned aside and piercing what could not.
Tamara did not invade immediately.
She focused on killing her personal guardian.

Her spear moved with brutal discipline, and her war intent formed the faint image of a battlefield behind her. The guardian copied her spear rhythm, but it could not copy her command. Tamara suddenly changed from direct combat to battlefield suppression, forcing the guardian into a corner of her crimson region where war runes had already gathered. Then she thrust her spear through its core.
[Participant Tamara Has Defeated Personal Guardian.]
[Bonus Genesis Flame Awarded.]
Revona used that moment to invade Varkhon’s black region while he was fighting Ervin.

Her Void Origin Eyes erased the defensive pull of his claimed region, allowing her to step inside without triggering the full penalty. She did not try to steal all his flames. She only reached for one unstable flame that had not yet stabilized.

But Varkhon sensed it and roared from Ervin’s region, punching across the distance. A wave of demonic strength tore toward Revona, but she looked at the weakest part of the force and erased enough of it to let the remaining impact pass around her.
She took the flame.
Varkhon laughed furiously. "All of you are thieves."
Tamara replied from her region, "You started with three stolen opportunities."
Max watched the movements of all four while facing his own personal guardian.

Revona looked at all of them.
Max’s personal guardian slowly rose again, its cracked sword hilt glowing as the hidden core repaired itself.
Then the final battle of the second trial began.
Varkhon invaded Ervin’s Blue Abyss Region first.
The demon crossed three platforms in a single leap, his fist descending like a meteor toward Ervin’s head.
Ervin did not retreat.
His spear rose and met the fist at an angle, redirecting most of the force while the ground beneath him cracked apart.
The two clashed violently, raw demonic strength against abyssal spearmanship.
Varkhon’s strikes were heavy enough to crush platforms, but Ervin’s spear always found the weakest point of each attack, turning aside what could be turned aside and piercing what could not.
Tamara did not invade immediately.
She focused on killing her personal guardian.
Her spear moved with brutal discipline, and her war intent formed the faint image of a battlefield behind her.
The guardian copied her spear rhythm, but it could not copy her command.
Tamara suddenly changed from direct combat to battlefield suppression, forcing the guardian into a corner of her crimson region where war runes had already gathered.
Then she thrust her spear through its core.
[Participant Tamara Has Defeated Personal Guardian.]
[Bonus Genesis Flame Awarded.]
Revona used that moment to invade Varkhon’s black region while he was fighting Ervin.
Her Void Origin Eyes erased the defensive pull of his claimed region, allowing her to step inside without triggering the full penalty.
She did not try to steal all his flames.
She only reached for one unstable flame that had not yet stabilized.
But Varkhon sensed it and roared from Ervin’s region, punching across the distance.
A wave of demonic strength tore toward Revona, but she looked at the weakest part of the force and erased enough of it to let the remaining impact pass around her.
She took the flame.
Varkhon laughed furiously.
"All of you are thieves."
Tamara replied from her region, "You started with three stolen opportunities."
Max watched the movements of all four while facing his own personal guardian.

chapters.title: Chapter 1799: End of the Second Trial!
paragraphs: The guardian had fully adapted to his earlier response. This time, its sword did not simply cut through space. It created multiple overlapping spaces, each one containing a different attack timing. For a normal cultivator, it would have been nearly impossible to identify which attack was real. For Max, it was only troublesome, not fatal.
His Dimensional Sovereign Body saw the entire structure.
He stepped through the first false space.
Cut the second.
Ignored the third.
Then thrust Dragonheart into the fourth, where the real core was hidden.
The guardian froze.
Max twisted the blade.
The core shattered.
[Participant Max Morgan Has Defeated Personal Guardian.]
[Bonus Genesis Flame Awarded.]
At the same time, Ervin’s spear pierced through his own personal guardian, which had tried to interfere in his battle with Varkhon.
[Participant Ervin Has Defeated Personal Guardian.]
[Bonus Genesis Flame Awarded.]
Varkhon saw two bonus flames appear and grinned wildly. "Good. More to steal."

He abandoned Ervin for a moment and rushed toward Max’s Gold Dominion Region, clearly deciding that the person with the most flames was the best target. Tamara also moved at the same time, not directly attacking Max but heading toward the boundary between her region and his. Revona remained near the center, her eyes glowing as if calculating the final flame’s appearance.
Max stood inside the Gold Dominion Region, several stabilized flames already secured and several unstable flames still circling him.
Varkhon arrived like a meteor.
His fist came down with all his strength.
Max raised his left arm and blocked it.
Boom!

The Gold Dominion Region shook violently, and the cubic ground beneath Max’s feet cracked in a wide circle. Varkhon’s raw strength was terrifying. Even among demons, he was clearly a monster, and his body seemed to contain enough brute force to tear apart ordinary geniuses.
But Max’s golden-black dragon scales appeared faintly on his arm, and with the support of his physical foundation, he held the punch without being forced back.
Varkhon’s grin widened. "Your body is strong too."
Max looked at him. "Strong enough."

Tamara’s spear suddenly came from the side, aiming not at Max’s body but at one of the unstable flames circling him. Max’s Dimensional Sovereign Body detected it instantly. He tilted his body, shifted the flame with spatial pressure, and let Tamara’s spear pass between him and Varkhon.
Varkhon immediately tried to grab the shifted flame.
Max kicked his wrist aside.
Ervin’s spear light arrived from the distance and struck another unstable flame near Max, pushing it toward the center.
Revona appeared there first.
Her Void Origin Eyes erased the flame’s resistance, and she took it.
Max glanced toward her.
Revona said calmly, "You were occupied."
Max smiled faintly. "Fair."
The timer reached the final minute.
A brilliant white flame appeared above the central core.
It was larger than the others.
The moment it appeared, every participant felt its value.
[Final Genesis Flame Appeared.]
[Final Genesis Flame Value: 3 Genesis Marks.]
The entire arena stilled for a fraction of a breath.
Then all five moved.
Varkhon abandoned Max and charged toward the center.
Tamara flew from the crimson region with her spear surrounded by war intent.
Revona’s Void Origin Eyes locked onto the space around the final flame.
Ervin’s spear pointed straight at its core path.
Max activated his Vein of Speed.
All five reached the central area almost at the same time.
Varkhon punched first, trying to blast everyone away.
Tamara’s spear met his fist and diverted the force upward.
Ervin’s spear pierced through the gap between them, aiming to hook the flame away.
Revona erased the spear force’s pull for an instant.
Max appeared above them and reached down.
The final flame reacted by splitting into five shadows, only one of which was real.
Max’s Dimensional Sovereign Body saw through it immediately.
But so did Revona’s Void Origin Eyes.
And somehow, Ervin’s abyss-like gaze also seemed to find the real one.
Three hands, one spear force, and one void gaze converged on the true flame at once.
The trial core trembled.
The final flame could not choose a direction.
Then Tamara made an unexpected move.

Instead of competing for the flame, she stabbed her spear into the platform and released a burst of war intent that froze Varkhon’s movement for a split second. Varkhon roared, but that instant was enough to keep him from reaching the flame first.
Ervin smiled faintly.
His spear force wrapped around the flame.
Revona’s eyes erased part of that pull.
Max’s hand passed through the gap between both powers, and for a moment, he almost took the flame.
But the black-haired Ervin suddenly changed his spear angle.
The abyssal aura around him deepened.
Max felt that bottomless feeling again, and the flame sank slightly as if pulled toward an unseen depth.
Max’s eyes sharpened.
His Dimensional Sovereign Body twisted space around the flame.
Revona’s Void Origin Eyes flashed brighter.
The final flame trembled violently between three powers.
Then the timer reached the final ten seconds.
The trial suddenly released a shockwave.
Everyone was pushed back half a step.
The final flame shot upward.
Max moved first.
Ervin moved second.
Revona moved third.
Their powers collided in the air, and the final flame cracked into three smaller white flames under the pressure of their simultaneous capture.
[Final Genesis Flame Split Due To Equal Claim Conflict.]
[Value Distributed Among Valid Claimants.]
Each of the three obtained one fragment.
Max landed back in the Gold Dominion Region.
Revona appeared near the silver region.
Ervin lowered his spear with a faint smile.
Varkhon stared at the result, then burst into loud laughter. "Even the trial could not decide."
Tamara pulled back her spear and exhaled. "Better than letting one person take all three."
The timer reached zero.
[Trial Two Completed.]
[Genesis Core Dominion Cleared.]
[Team Cooperation Assessment: High.]
[Competitive Performance Assessment: Exceptional.]
[Survival Contribution Assessment: Completed.]
[Genesis Flame Stabilization Completed.]
[Genesis Marks Distribution In Progress...]
The arena stopped moving.
The guardians froze and dissolved into cube dust.
The outer regions dimmed one by one.

For a moment, the five stood in silence, each surrounded by the fading glow of the flames they had secured. None of them had truly trusted the others, and none of them had held back from competing, yet the trial had forced them into a strange balance where cooperation and conflict had both been necessary.
A new prompt appeared.
[Trial Two Results:]
[Max Morgan: 12 Genesis Marks]
[Ervin: 8 Genesis Marks]
[Revona: 7 Genesis Marks]
[Tamara: 5 Genesis Marks]
[Varkhon: 3 Genesis Marks]
[Total Genesis Marks Distributed In Trial Two: 35/35]
[Current Genesis Mark Totals:]
[Max Morgan: 21/100]
[Revona: 13/100]
[Tamara: 10/100]
[Varkhon: 6/100]
Varkhon looked at the totals and clicked his tongue. "Again with three."
Tamara glanced at him. "You spent half the trial trying to punch people instead of reading the rules."
Varkhon grinned. "Punching people is how I read rules."
Revona looked at Max’s total calmly. "You are far ahead."
Ervin also looked at the prompt, then at Max. "For now."

Max did not respond immediately. His gaze moved from the system prompt to the cubic sky above them. The first two trials had already distributed sixty-five Genesis Marks, and there were only thirty-five left. That meant the third trial would decide the final ranking, and judging by the structure so far, it would likely be far more dangerous than the previous two.
As if confirming his thought, the arena beneath them began to sink into the void.
The central core broke apart.
The five participants were swallowed by white light once again.
[Preparing Final Trial.]
[Trial Three: Genesis Sovereign Descent.]
[Maximum Genesis Marks Obtainable In Trial Three: 35]
[Warning: Final Trial Will Determine Genesis Ranking.]
[Warning: Death Or Elimination In Final Trial Will Result In Loss Of Unstabilized Genesis Marks.]
[Warning: The Final Trial May Be Completed By One Participant, Multiple Participants, Or No Participants.]
The white light deepened.
Max’s eyes became sharper.
The third trial was coming.

chapters.title: Chapter 1800: Last Trial - 1
paragraphs: Just at that moment, a while light descended upon them.
The white light swallowed the five participants completely.

For a moment, Max could not see the arena, the Genesis Core, the outer regions, or even the others beside him. Everything around him became pure whiteness, but unlike ordinary light, this whiteness did not feel warm or sacred. It felt empty. It felt unfinished.
It was the kind of light that existed before color, before form, before direction, and for a brief instant, Max felt as if he had been thrown back into the beginning of something vast and unknown.
Then the system prompt appeared.
[Final Trial Initiated.]
[Trial Three: Genesis Sovereign Descent.]
[Maximum Genesis Marks Obtainable In Trial Three: 35]
[Trial Type: Sovereign Assessment.]
[Objective: Climb The Genesis Sovereign Platform And Obtain Recognition From The Genesis Throne.]
[Rules: Participants May Cooperate, Compete, Or Eliminate One Another.]
[Rules: Genesis Marks Will Be Awarded According To Ascent Height, Combat Contribution, Willpower, Path Manifestation, And Throne Recognition.]
[Warning: The Genesis Sovereign Platform Will Continuously Suppress All Participants.]
[Warning: The Higher One Climbs, The Stronger The Suppression Becomes.]
[Warning: At The Final Stage, Only One Participant May Stand Before The Genesis Throne.]
[Trial Three Begins Now.]
The white light shattered.
Max appeared in a vast open space that looked nothing like the previous two trials.

There was no cubic room this time. There was no labyrinth and no circular arena. Instead, they stood at the base of an enormous platform rising into a starless sky. The platform was made of countless layered cubes, each layer wider than a city and higher than a mountain.

Every cube was engraved with ancient white-gold patterns, and the entire structure gave off a pressure that made the air feel heavy enough to crush weaker cultivators into the ground. At the very top of the platform, far beyond ordinary sight, a faint throne could be seen floating above everything, surrounded by a halo of colorless light.
The Genesis Throne.
Even before the system named it again, everyone understood that the throne was the true center of the final trial.
Max looked upward silently.

His Dimensional Sovereign Body spread through the space around him, but this time, his perception could not cover the whole structure. The Genesis Sovereign Platform seemed to resist being seen completely.

Whenever his senses climbed too high, the white-gold patterns on the cubes shifted and pushed his perception back down. It was not like the first trial, where he could read the labyrinth and guide everyone through hidden routes. Here, the trial was openly telling them one thing.
Climb.
Endure.
Prove yourself.
Beside him, Revona’s Void Origin Eyes glowed softly, but even she frowned slightly after looking toward the top. "My eyes cannot see the throne clearly."
Tamara tightened her grip on her spear. "So the final trial is a pressure ascent."
Varkhon grinned, but the grin was heavier than before. "Good. No more chasing flames. No more strange rules. Just climb and crush whatever stands in the way."

Ervin stood quietly, black spear in hand, his fathomless aura still calm. His gaze remained fixed on the distant throne, and for the first time, Max felt a faint ripple in that bottomless presence, as if even Ervin was genuinely interested in what waited at the top.
Then another prompt appeared.
[Current Genesis Mark Totals:]
[Max Morgan: 21/100]
[Revona: 13/100]
[Tamara: 10/100]
[Varkhon: 6/100]
[Final Trial Genesis Marks Available: 35]
[Notice: Current Ranking Does Not Guarantee Final Ranking.]
[Notice: Genesis Throne Recognition May Alter Final Distribution.]
Varkhon looked at the prompt and laughed. "So I still have a chance."
Tamara glanced at him. "Only if you climb better than you read rules."
Varkhon’s grin widened. "I understand climbing."
Revona remained calm. "The final stage only allows one participant before the throne. That means cooperation will eventually end."
Ervin nodded faintly. "But perhaps not at the beginning. A platform this large will not only suppress us. It will likely send guardians, illusions, path trials, and attacks based on our foundations."
Max looked at the steps rising ahead.

The first layer of the Genesis Sovereign Platform was already releasing a steady pressure, and they had not even begun climbing yet. His body could easily endure it, but the nature of the pressure was strange. It did not only weigh on flesh. It pressed against aura, bloodline, soul, will, comprehension, and even the Pseudo Cosmic Paths hidden within them.
Max said calmly, "We climb first. Compete when we have to."
Tamara nodded. "Agreed."
Revona said, "Agreed."
Varkhon snorted. "Fine. But if the trial says only one can reach the throne, do not blame me when I start punching."
Ervin smiled faintly. "No one here expected otherwise."
With that, the five began moving.
The moment Max stepped onto the first layer of the Genesis Sovereign Platform, the pressure descended.
Boom!
The air around them sank violently.

Tamara’s war intent flared at once. Varkhon’s demonic markings glowed. Revona’s Void Origin Eyes deepened. Ervin’s abyss-like aura became sharper. Max’s golden-black scales did not appear yet, but the strength of his body stirred instinctively as the Genesis pressure tried to force him to lower his head.
Max did not slow down.
He took another step.
Then another.
The others moved with him.

At first, the ascent seemed simple. The pressure grew with each layer, but none of the five were ordinary. They climbed steadily, their footsteps echoing across the massive cube steps. The lower layers only tested basic endurance, and even Varkhon, who had the fewest Genesis Marks, moved with ease because his raw physical body was terrifyingly strong.
Tamara’s war intent surrounded her like an invisible army, making every step feel like a march into battle.

Revona used her Void Origin Eyes to erase part of the pressure pressing against her soul. Ervin walked as if the abyss beneath his aura swallowed the weight before it could truly affect him. Max relied on his body, his foundation, and the subtle support of his Dimensional Sovereign Body to sense which parts of the pressure were physical and which were conceptual.
After the tenth layer, the first obstacle appeared.
The cubes ahead shifted, and from the white-gold patterns carved into the platform, five figures emerged.
Each figure looked like one of the participants.
